$comment: The ONE secret-shaped ruleset for this repository. Two divergent secret regexes would be a real hazard: one gate would redact what another missed. Consumed by scripts/redact.mjs, scripts/check-ledger.mjs (EPIC-08), and scripts/gen-gitleaks-config.mjs (EPIC-03), which GENERATES build/gitleaks.mist.toml from this file at CI time rather than forking it -- and never commits a .gitleaks.toml, which the no-suppression assertion forbids. Patterns carry an explicit `flags` field because JavaScript has no inline (?i)/(?m) syntax; consumers compile regex+flags. gitleaks uses Go's RE2, which has no lookahead, lookbehind or backreferences: a `patterns` entry using one is a HARD ERROR in the generator, not a rule that silently never fires. The personalDataPatterns below are JavaScript-only (two use negative lookahead) and are not translated to gitleaks.
owner: EPIC-03 (generator + gitleaks ruleset); EPIC-08 (redaction + ledger gate). Changes affect both -- run test-ledger.mjs AND test-scan.mjs.

patterns.description: key/token/secret assigned a long opaque value
32 hex characters standing alone -- the shape of the weather API keys Mist uses (K1/K2, docs/KEY_ROTATION.md)
a PEM private key, header through footer -- redacting only the header would leave the key body in the transcript
three base64url segments separated by dots

personalDataPatterns.description: absolute path through a user's home directory -- leaks a username
any email address NOT at example.invalid (deploy/real-mail-domains.txt is the fixture-data rule; transcripts are stricter -- only example.invalid survives)
a shell environment dump line; the variable name is kept, the value removed
